Proposed: Franken
research: The archival abstract explicitly describes the Oggersheim Schultheiß Michael Rosenberger as Hans Dentz’s son-in-law. Dentz and Philipp Sturmfeder guarantee the same ten-year inn lease and 18-gulden rent as in 1499-09-28.json. The marriage settlement in 1497-03-21.json names his father as Michael von Rosenberg, plausibly the Michael associated with the Bauland castle fief in 1490-10-28.json under the same elector. This chain supports Franken over a Rosenegg attribution based on the shared Rosenberger spelling.

entries.german:
Philipp Sturmfeder [von Oppenweiler] und Hans Dentz bekunden, dass sie für ihren guten Freund Michael (Michel) Rosenberger, Schultheiß zu Oggersheim und Hans' Tochtermann, Bürgen gegenüber Kurfürst Philipp von der Pfalz geworden sind. Dieser hat Michael Rosenberger um einen jährlichen Zins von 18 Gulden die Herberge zu Oggersheim für 10 Jahre verliehen. Die Aussteller versprechen Bezahlung des Zinses, falls Michael daran säumig werden sollte, wobei auch ihre gesamte liegende und fahrende Habe pfandbar sein soll. Philipp Sturmfeder kündigt sein "angeborn ingesigle", Hans Dentz sein aufgedrücktes Gemerk (gemercke) an dieser Urkunde an.

Laufzeit: 1499 Oktober 4 (uff sant Franciscus tag)

Siegler: Philipp Sturmfeder (angeborn ingesigle); Hans Dentz (gemercke)
entries.english:
Philipp Sturmfeder [von Oppenweiler] and Hans Dentz declare that they have become guarantors for their good friend Michael Rosenberger, Schultheiß zu Oggersheim and son-in-law of Hans, before Elector Philipp of the Palatinate. The Elector has granted Michael Rosenberger the inn at Oggersheim for 10 years in exchange for an annual rent of 18 gulden. The issuers promise payment of the rent should Michael default, whereby all their real and personal property shall be subject to pledge. Philipp Sturmfeder affixes his "inherited seal" (angeborn ingesigle), Hans Dentz his impressed mark (gemercke) to this document.

Term: 1499 October 4 (on St. Francis's Day)

Sealers: Philipp Sturmfeder (inherited seal); Hans Dentz (impressed mark)

facts.content: stood surety with Philipp Sturmfeder von Oppenweiler to Philipp, Kurfürst von der Pfalz, for the annual rent owed by Michael Rosenberger, Schultheiß zu Oggersheim, on the Oggersheim inn.
